subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns become network-enabled by default for existing users?
rationale: The PR changes a sandbox network boundary and the repository policy requires maintainer-visible security and upgrade intent before accepting that default change.

options.title: Keep default denied
options.body: Preserve networkAccess false for workspace-write and add any needed network behavior through an explicit opt-in or narrower owner-approved path.

options.title: Accept network-enabled default
options.body: Land the default change only with explicit maintainer security approval, docs, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof for affected app-server flows.

options.title: Split the bundle
options.body: Move the TUI/browser/auth repairs separately while pausing the sandbox-default decision for a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep default denied
recommendation.body: Preserve networkAccess false for workspace-write and add any needed network behavior through an explicit opt-in or narrower owner-approved path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history touches the Codex app-server sandbox helper and adjacent auth/status surfaces most directly.
